ARABIC LANGUAGE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: ARABIC LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Guided Reading: Fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Guided Reading: Fluency.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Guided Reading: Fluency.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Guided Reading: Fluency.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Guided Reading: Fluency.

2. When practising Imitative Speaking: Pronunciation, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Imitative Speaking: Pronunciation.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Imitative Speaking: Pronunciation.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Imitative Speaking: Pronunciation.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Imitative Speaking: Pronunciation.

3. When practising Listening for Gist: Attentive Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Listening for Gist: Attentive Listening.

   C. Copy random text without understanding Listening for Gist: Attentive Listening.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for Gist: Attentive Listening.

4. When practising Phonological Awareness: Pronunciation, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Phonological Awareness: Pronunciation.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Phonological Awareness: Pronunciation.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Phonological Awareness: Pronunciation.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Phonological Awareness: Pronunciation.

5. When practising Conversational Skills, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Conversational Skills.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Conversational Skills.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Conversational Skills.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Conversational Skills.

6. When practising Attentive Listening: Simple Instructions, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Attentive Listening: Simple Instructions.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Attentive Listening: Simple Instructions.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Attentive Listening: Simple Instructions.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Attentive Listening: Simple Instructions.

7. When practising Phonological Awareness: Fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Phonological Awareness: Fluency.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Phonological Awareness: Fluency.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Phonological Awareness: Fluency.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Phonological Awareness: Fluency.

8. In ARABIC LANGUAGE, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   B. Only memorise without using the language
   C. Avoid speaking to classmates
   D. Mix random languages with no purpose

9. When practising Language Use, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Language Use.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language Use.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Language Use.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Language Use.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
10. In three clear sentences, explain Conversational Skills and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

11. In three clear sentences, explain Imitative Speaking: Pronunciation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Language Use and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Reading: Fluency and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
